basic_details.short_information: GSSSB Senior Industries Inspector Recruitment 2026 notification has been released on 24 July 2026 on the official website gsssb.gujarat.gov.in. A total of 1 vacancy has been announced through the GSSSB Senior Industries Inspector Recruitment 2026 under the Special Recruitment Drive for Divyang (Low Vision) candidates.

application_fee.details: Fee must be paid online only - via Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallet - through the OJAS portal. Applicable transaction charges apply in addition to the exam fee. The fee is refunded to candidates who actually appear for the examination; it is not refunded to candidates who do not appear. Fee must be paid by 13/08/2026, 11:59 PM. Applications without fee payment are not considered valid.

age_limit.details: As on 10/08/2026, the candidate's age must not be less than 18 years and not more than 35 years. Candidates already in Gujarat Government service may get upper age relaxation as per the 1967 Rules. Divyang candidates get the following additional relaxation (subject to a maximum age cap of 45 years in all cases):

qualification.details: As per the recruitment rules notified by the Industries and Mines Department, candidates must possess: | A Second Class Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology (excluding Civil Engineering) from a recognized Central/State university or an institution deemed to be a university under the UGC Act, 1956; or A Diploma in Engineering (excluding Civil Engineering) from the Technical Examination Board or a recognized university/institution, or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government; and | In addition, candidates must have: | About 2 years of experience in a post not below the rank of Junior Industries Inspector, Class-3, in the subordinate services of the Commissionerate of Industries, Gujarat State; or About 2 years of practical experience in production or manufacturing of goods in Government, Local Body, Government undertaking, Board, Corporation, or a Limited Company established under the Companies Act, 2013, in a post equivalent to Junior Industries Inspector, Class-3. | Candidates must also possess basic knowledge of computer applications as prescribed under the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967, and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi, or both. | Note: The application form captures only the key qualification points. The final selection will strictly follow all provisions of the detailed recruitment rules, so candidates must review the full rules before filling the online form.

content_sections.heading: Gujarat GSSSB Senior Industries Inspector Vacancy 2026 Out
content_sections.text: As per the official notification, GSSSB is inviting applications for a total of 1 post of Senior Industries Inspector, Class-3, reserved for candidates with Low Vision (LV) disability, with disability in the range of 40% to 70%. The notification clarifies that the number of vacancies is subject to change, and this drive does not reserve separate category-wise seats within the Divyang quota - selected candidates are adjusted against their respective social category (SC/ST/SEBC/EWS/General) as declared in the application.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Senior Industries Inspector Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The candidate must be a citizen of India, or possess the nationality prescribed under Rule 7 of the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967. Only candidates possessing a valid disability certificate under the Low Vision (LV) category, with a disability percentage between 40% and 70%, are eligible to apply for this specific vacancy, as this Special Recruitment Drive targets a specific disability-group backlog.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Senior Industries Inspector Educational Qualification 2026
content_sections.text: As per the recruitment rules notified by the Industries and Mines Department, candidates must possess: A Second Class Bachelor's degree in Engineering or Technology (excluding Civil Engineering) from a recognized Central/State university or an institution deemed to be a university under the UGC Act, 1956; or A Diploma in Engineering (excluding Civil Engineering) from the Technical Examination Board or a recognized university/institution, or an equivalent qualification recognized by the Government; and In addition, candidates must have: About 2 years of experience in a post not below the rank of Junior Industries Inspector, Class-3, in the subordinate services of the Commissionerate of Industries, Gujarat State; or About 2 years of practical experience in production or manufacturing of goods in Government, Local Body, Government undertaking, Board, Corporation, or a Limited Company established under the Companies Act, 2013, in a post equivalent to Junior Industries Inspector, Class-3. Candidates must also possess basic knowledge of computer applications as prescribed under the Gujarat Civil Services Classification and Recruitment (General) Rules, 1967, and adequate knowledge of Gujarati or Hindi, or both. Note: The application form captures only the key qualification points. The final selection will strictly follow all provisions of the detailed recruitment rules, so candidates must review the full rules before filling the online form.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Senior Industries Inspector Age Limit 2026
content_sections.text: As on 10/08/2026, the candidate's age must not be less than 18 years and not more than 35 years. Candidates already in Gujarat Government service may get upper age relaxation as per the 1967 Rules. Divyang candidates get the following additional relaxation (subject to a maximum age cap of 45 years in all cases):

content_sections.text: Fee must be paid online only - via Debit Card, Internet Banking, UPI, or Wallet - through the OJAS portal. Applicable transaction charges apply in addition to the exam fee. content_sections.heading: GSSSB Senior Industries Inspector Apply Online 2026
content_sections.text: Each candidate should submit only one application. If multiple applications are submitted, only the last confirmed application (with fee paid) will be considered valid; earlier applications and their fees will be treated as cancelled and non-refundable.

content_sections.heading: GSSSB Senior Industries Inspector Recruitment 2026 Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made through a single-stage Computer Based Response Test (CBRT) / OMR-based Multiple Choice Question (MCQ) examination, divided into two parts: Total questions: 210 (90 in Part A + 120 in Part B). Total duration: 3 hours (180 minutes) for both parts combined. Negative marking: 1/4th of the marks allotted to a question is deducted for every wrong answer. Minimum qualifying standard: 40% in Part A and 40% in Part B, separately, for all categories. After the exam, GSSSB will publish a Provisional Answer Key, followed by a Final Answer Key after considering objections. Based on the merit list, candidates (approximately twice the number of vacancies) will be called for document verification, after which the final selection list and waiting list will be published. Part A - Reasoning & Data Interpretation (30 Marks): Coding-Decoding, Blood Relations, Age and Height problems, Direction Sense, Clock and Calendar, Venn Diagrams, Ranking, Series, Analogy, Data Interpretation, Symmetry, Probability, and related analytical topics. Part A - Quantitative Aptitude (30 Marks): Number System, LCM-HCF, Percentage, Profit-Loss, Simple/Compound Interest, Ratio-Proportion, Time-Work-Distance, Averages, Algebra, Mensuration, Coordinate Geometry, and Trigonometry. Part A - Constitution of India (10 Marks), Current Affairs (10 Marks) and Comprehension (10 Marks - Gujarati 5 + English 5): Covers the Preamble, Fundamental Rights and Duties, Directive Principles, Union and State legislature/executive/judiciary, local self-government, elections, current regional/national/international events, and reading comprehension passages. Part B - Technical (120 Marks): Basic Mechanical Engineering (20 marks), Basic Electrical Engineering (20 marks), Basic Electronics Engineering (20 marks), Basic Computer Engineering (20 marks), and Industries Policy (40 marks) covering the Atmanirbhar Gujarat Scheme 2022, Gujarat Textile Policy 2024, MSMED Act 2006, Purchase Policy 2024, Startup Policy of Gujarat, and Ease of Doing Business (EODB).

faq.answer: There is 1 (one) vacancy, reserved for Divyang candidates under the Low Vision (LV, 40%-70%) category, as part of a Special Recruitment Drive.
